question: After the dependency lands and this branch is rebased, should this command-ledger implementation be enabled across ClawSweeper’s live mutating workflows?
rationale: The design is aligned and no concrete defect was found, but repository policy requires explicit human acceptance and real-lane proof for changes to mutation, recovery, and public automation state.

options.title: Approve after hosted exact-head proof
options.body: Rebase onto main and require successful, retry, timeout, forced-replay, requeue, and publication artifacts from the exact head before merge.

options.title: Split the operational surfaces
options.body: Separate router mutation receipts from status/requeue and broad workflow publication if one proof path cannot bound the combined risk clearly.

options.title: Pause the ledger rollout
options.body: Keep existing automation unchanged if the added recovery and publication state cannot be proven or maintained safely.

recommendation.title: Approve after hosted exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Rebase onto main and require successful, retry, timeout, forced-replay, requeue, and publication artifacts from the exact head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current ledger stack and have the strongest current-main history in the affected router and workflow paths.
